prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Mourn Ashwake. Character visual motifs: furnace-backed mortician pulling ember caskets on chains, black glass face shield; no Shadow-Fiend-style line razes/soul-stack requiem.
TOP LEFT: Ash Residue. Ability concept: any completed damaging spell cast within 125 GU leaves an Ash Patch where it ended (once / owner / 4 s, max 4 patches). Mourn sees both teams' visible patches.
TOP RIGHT: Ember Tongs. Ability concept: drags one patch slowly 45 GU, scorching enemies it passes once, or makes a small patch at his own feet if none exist.
BOTTOM LEFT: Draft Open. Ability concept: opens a furnace vent toward one patch, creating a visibly directional heated current for 3 s that burns enemies walking **against** it.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Second Combustion. Ability concept: ignites every active patch in a 140-GU field after 1.0 s, turning them into low moving walls of ember for 3 s. Patches consumed; no large instant fear wave.
